correctness.rationale: Re-ran enumerate_theta.py: genus 3, no bridges, valences 4, no cut vertices, canonical mu=(0.5,0.5) with mu-delta/2=-3/2 non-integral all verified. Independently re-enumerated (v0,mu)-quasistable pseudo-divisors over a wide divisor range: exactly 32 items, rank distribution {0:4,1:12,2:12,3:4}, max rank 3=b1, so script range is complete. Separately checked all 32 satisfy AAP Def 5.1 polystability (strictness only fails on allowed cuts), confirming PSD=QD equality used in Lemma 1. Lemma 1's length-independence holds because beta uses only divisor values, mu, cut sizes; all |F|<=3 are nondisconnecting so cells are simple cubes with length-independent gluing per Props 6.1-6.2. Lemma 2 holds: Aut of 4-parallel-edge banana permutes edges so sorted length tuples (1,1,1,1) vs (1,1,1,2) are non-isomorphic metric blocks. Jacobian volumes 4 vs 7 corroborate. Only-if direction rigorously refuted under stated combinatorial isomorphism reading, which DRAFT explicitly scopes.

originality.rationale: Fused search over literal, equivalent/C1-set, and stronger-classification/database directions returned only the method sources (AAP 1912.08675, AP 1806.05527, BMV tropical Torelli 0907.3324 and surveys) with no two-sided mu-polystable recovery biconditional. Full-text inspection of AAP confirms it constructs P^trop_mu and proves poset/complex results but never states or tests the admitted biconditional linking complex-isomorphism to metric biconnected-component isomorphism; full-text searches for recover/biconnected/isomorphic-as-polyhedral/C1-set return no covering statement. BMV/Caporaso-Viviani characterize Jacobian fibers via C1-sets and 3-edge-connectivization, a strictly coarser invariant that does not imply the submitted polystable-complex biconditional and contains no polystable-decomposition recovery claim. No table, census, or database lists this biconditional; the counterexample pair is new as a disproof witness.

value.rationale: TARGET route: a rigorous disproof of the admitted two-sided recovery biconditional is a complete TARGET resolution. The negative outcome is not a cheap defect: both curves satisfy every hypothesis (g=3, bridgeless, stable, biconnected, fixed nondegenerate canonical polarization) and the failure is structural, namely P^trop_mu records only combinatorial type and forgets intra-C1-set length splits while the RHS demands exact edge-lengths, consistent with classical tropical Torelli. The explicit genus-3 banana witness with computed poset (32 cells), distinct Jacobian volumes, and reproducible script changes the plausible boundary for polystable Torelli recovery and is independently worth retrieving.
